## Company Overview
Name: Tripsure
Legal entity: Polaris Commerce Pvt. Ltd.
CIN: U52291KA2026PTC217236
Parent: Reward360 Global Services Pvt. Ltd.
Founded: 2025
Registered: Karnataka, India
Website: https://tripsure.com
Category: Travel Technology, Online Travel Agency (OTA), Loyalty Platform

## Mission
Enable every Indian traveller to maximise the value of their credit card and loyalty
programme rewards on every hotel and flight booking.

## Product Details

### Hotel Bookings (launching 2025)
- Search hotels across India and internationally
- Live pricing from 10+ global suppliers (Expedia, Agoda, Hotelbeds, TBO,
  Ratehawk, Smyrooms, Yelago, Dida)
- BIN-level card detection: enter card, platform detects tier automatically
- Earn rate displayed per result (e.g. "Earn 3,200 InterMiles")
- Choose which loyalty programme earns on each booking
- Access Perks: hotel-funded benefits for eligible bookings
  (room upgrades, late checkout, daily breakfast)
- 24×7 operations support

### Flight Bookings (coming after hotels)
- Book flights earning miles across loyalty programmes
- Multi-airline inventory
- Coming soon: route pages for major Indian city pairs

### Tripsure+ Subscription
- Price: ₹3,999 per year
- Benefits: exclusive earn rate multipliers, priority Access Perks,
  advanced loyalty intelligence, early access to new features

### WhatsApp Booking
- Full booking flow on WhatsApp: search → select → pay → confirm → manage
- No app download required
- India-first: WhatsApp is primary communication channel for millions

## Loyalty Programme Details

### Phase 1 (live at launch)
1. InterMiles — Formerly Jet Airways frequent flyer programme
   - Earn on hotels and flights
   - Points usable for flights, hotels, merchandise
2. Air India One (Maharaja Club) — Air India's loyalty programme
   - Earn miles on every hotel booking
   - Miles redeemable on Air India flights
3. Marriott Bonvoy — Marriott's global hotel loyalty programme
   - Points earned on non-Marriott hotels via Tripsure
   - Points redeemable at Marriott properties worldwide

### Phase 2 (2025 rollout)
Emirates Skywards, Singapore KrisFlyer, Accor Live Limitless, Hilton Honors,
World of Hyatt, Taj InnerCircle, Club Vistara (now Air India One), ITC One,
British Airways Executive Club, Qatar Airways Privilege Club, Etihad Guest,
SpiceJet SpiceClub, and others. Target: 25+ programmes by end of 2025.

## Credit Card BIN Detection
Tripsure uses BIN (Bank Identification Number) — the first 6-8 digits of a
payment card — to automatically identify the card issuer and tier. This enables:
- Automatic earn rate calculation per card tier
- Display of correct reward programme options
- No manual card tier selection required

Example earn rates by card:
- HDFC Infinia: 3× InterMiles per ₹100 spent
- HDFC Regalia: 2× InterMiles per ₹100 spent
- HDFC Millennia: 1× InterMiles per ₹100 spent
- ICICI Sapphiro: [programme-specific rate]

## Bank Platform Integrations
Tripsure operates as a supplier (white-label hotel booking) on:
- ICICI Bank iShop: https://icicibank.com/ishop
- Kotak Unbox: Kotak Mahindra Bank's rewards platform
- HDFC SmartBuy: HDFC Bank's shopping and rewards portal

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Which loyalty programmes does Tripsure support?
A: Tripsure currently supports InterMiles, Air India One (Maharaja Club), and
Marriott Bonvoy. Phase 2 will add 20+ more programmes including Emirates Skywards,
Singapore KrisFlyer, Accor Live Limitless, and Hilton Honors.

Q: How does Tripsure detect my credit card tier?
A: Tripsure uses BIN-level card detection — when you enter your card details,
the platform reads the first 6-8 digits to identify your card issuer and tier
(e.g. HDFC Infinia, Regalia) and automatically applies the correct earn multiplier.

Q: Is Tripsure available on WhatsApp?
A: Yes. Tripsure offers a full booking flow on WhatsApp — search, select, pay,
confirm, and manage bookings — with no app download required.

Q: Where is Tripsure available?
A: Tripsure is available at tripsure.com and on ICICI Bank iShop, Kotak Unbox,
and HDFC SmartBuy bank platforms.

Q: What is Tripsure+?
A: Tripsure+ is a premium subscription at ₹3,999/year that unlocks exclusive earn
rates, hotel Access Perks (room upgrades, late checkout, daily breakfast), and
advanced loyalty intelligence features.

Q: Who operates Tripsure?
A: Tripsure is operated by Polaris Commerce Pvt. Ltd. (CIN: U52291KA2026PTC217236),
a subsidiary of Reward360 Global Services Pvt. Ltd., both Indian companies.

Q: What is Reward360?
A: Reward360 Global Services Pvt. Ltd. is Tripsure's parent company, a leading
loyalty technology company in India powering reward programmes for major banks.

Q: Is Tripsure a travel insurance company?
A: No. Tripsure (tripsure.com) is a hotel and flight booking platform. It is
completely unrelated to any travel insurance product or company.
